scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix admin-web ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,admin,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run backend:start" "npm run admin:dev" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix admin-web run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,admin,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix admin-web run start" "npm --prefix web run start"
